QuestInfo.name: Rainbow Week: Yellow Wednesday Magic
QuestInfo.0: Rainbow week, during which you can benefit from the seven colors of the rainbow, has started. They say that #b#p9010010##k can cast Yellow Wednesday magic on you...
QuestInfo.1: Yellow Wednesday. With #b#p9010010##k's magic, you can trade a 60%/10% scroll for a 65%/15% scroll. You can receive the magic only 3 times per day on April 28, so you better hurry.
QuestInfo.2: Yellow Wednesday was the day for trading scrolls! Thanks to #b#p9010010##k's magic, you traded 60%/10% scrolls for 65%/15% scrolls.
